description: Reports a suspected error in data this service returned, for one series or one endpoint, to the operator: a kind from a fixed list and an optional short text (at most 500 characters), e.g. country, period and the value the publisher shows. Side effects: only stores the report for a manual check against the source; it changes no data, returns no data, and nobody replies. Text that looks like an email address, phone or account number is refused and not stored. When to use: only when a value from this service disagrees with its source or is clearly broken, not for questions or data requests. No API key; at most 10 reports a day per client, not counted against the data quota.

apiId.description: Endpoint id the value came from, e.g. fx-currency-convert (call_api or ask_anything), in place of series

params.description: The params of that call_api call, so the same answer can be checked

series.description: Series id the value came from, e.g. fx.EUR.USD (get_series or a candidate)

name: report_issue
title: Report a wrong value
